_doc: probe_attacks.py checks for movement I (score qn). ref: isolated attacks after a rest of 2 qn or more (fast samples 0.06 s; soft string entries 0.20 s); opening: tracks sounding in the first 1.5 s. c03: Timpani limit 0.12 s (strokes start TIMP_DELAY_S = 0.06 s after the score onset); starts are measured from 0.3 s before the onset.
